title: SONATA Dose Duration LIFU for OCD
official: Subcortical OCD Neuromodulation With Acoustic Therapy - Dose Duration Optimization
summary: This study is testing a new, non-invasive brain stimulation approach for adults with Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD). Researchers are evaluating the safety, tolerability, and target engagement of low-intensity focused ultrasound (LIFU) directed at a brain region called the subthalamic nucleus (STN). The ultrasound is delivered using a wearable device called ATTN201 (developed by Attune Neurosciences).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age 22-80
2. Meet DSM-V criteria for OCD ≥ 1 year with a Y-BOCS score ≥ 16
3. Must be on the same stable dose(s) of OCD medication for at least 4 weeks prior to screening and throughout the course of the study

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Co-morbid psychiatric disorder other than depression or anxiety disorder
2. Active suicidal risk (defined by C-SSRS)
3. History of neurological condition
4. Pregnant or breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the study period
